verdict.rationale: Devin exposes 'knowledge' and 'playbooks' via its API/MCP layer and integrates DeepWiki for auto-generated architecture docs, which could serve as a shared source of truth, but there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated 'workspace' feature for aggregating team docs and repos into one place. missing for 10: explicit workspace/knowledge-base creation UI, team-wide document ingestion features, and independent evidence of teams using it as a shared source of truth.
